title: Joseline Hernandez Denies Knowing Big Lex Involved in Violent Las Vegas Brawl [Watch]
htmlContent:
In a recent interview on The Breakfast Club, reality TV star Joseline Hernandez addressed the controversial brawl she was involved in during the Floyd Mayweather vs. John Gotti III fight in Las Vegas. The incident, captured on video, showed Joseline brutally beating a woman named Big Lex, who had previously appeared on her Zeus show, Joseline's Cabaret. Despite their prior association, Joseline now claims to have no knowledge of the woman she was seen attacking.

During the interview, Joseline defended herself, asserting that she was merely defending herself and that the media had blown the incident out of proportion. She explained that the public might not be aware of the events leading up to the brawl, emphasizing her need to protect herself in any situation. According to Joseline, the media often portrays her actions in a sensationalized manner, amplifying the chaos and overlooking the circumstances that preceded it.

Furthermore, Joseline denied allegations that her husband, Balistic Beats, had been physically involved in the altercation. She passionately vouched for his character, stating that he would never lay a hand on a woman. Addressing rumors of drug use during the brawl, Joseline admitted to enjoying a party but insisted that she was currently clean from drugs, including cocaine. She dismissed the notion that she was under the influence during the incident, proclaiming her newfound strength and independence without any crutches.

However, the most surprising claim came when Joseline flat-out denied knowing Big Lex. Using derogatory language, she asserted that neither she nor guest host Jess Hilarious had any familiarity with the woman she fought. This statement contradicts their previous professional relationship and raises questions about the authenticity of Joseline's denial.

As the interview concluded, the public was left to form their own opinions regarding Joseline Hernandez's version of events. The blurred lines between reality television and actuality make it challenging to discern the truth. The saga surrounding this headline-making brawl in Las Vegas continues to captivate audiences, with many eagerly awaiting further developments and revelations.
